blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur—The National Food Authority (NFA) in the Ilocos Region is buying clean, dry palay at P30 per kilogram in La Union, Pangasinan, Ilocos Norte, and Ilocos Sur for one week starting Monday, while offering P29 per kilogram in the Cordillera province of Abra. Based on an NFA Region 1 advisory on Monday, the P30-per-kilo buying price applies to Ilocos palay with a moisture content of 11 to 14 percent. In Abra, which is adjacent to Ilocos, the buying price is set at P29 per kilo for palay meeting the same quality and moisture requirements. READ: NFA procurement plan […]...
